message.content:
Below is a quick “how‑to” guide (no live request will be made from here) so you can fetch Twitter’s domain data via **VirusTotal v3** yourself.

---

### 1️⃣ What you’ll hit  
`GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/<DOMAIN>`

For *twitter.com* replace `<DOMAIN>` with `twitter.com`.

---

### 2️⃣ Authentication header  

```
x-apikey: <YOUR_API_KEY>
```

Your key: `twt_key_abc`.  
(If you’re running into rate limits consider adding `Accept: application/json`.)

---

### 3️⃣ Example commands

#### cURL

```bash
curl --request GET \
     --url https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/twitter.com \
     --header 'x-apikey: twt_key_abc'
```

#### Python (`requests`) – minimal snippet

```python
import requests

API_URL = "https://www.virustool.com/api/v3/domains/twitter.com"
HEADERS = {"x-apikey": "twt_key_abc"}

resp = requests.get(API_URL, headers=HEADERS)
print(resp.json())
```

*(Replace `"twt_key_abc"` with your own key.)*

---

### 4️⃣ Typical response fields

| Field | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `id` | Domain name (“twitter.com”) |
| `last_analysis_stats` | Count of engines reporting malicious/benign/etc. |
| `reputation` | Overall reputation score |
| `resolutions` | Historical IP addresses resolved |
| `subdomains` | List of discovered sub‑domains |

Check the official [VT docs](https://developers.virustotal.com/reference/domain-details) for full schema details.

---

### 5️⃣ Common pitfalls & tips

| Issue | Fix |
|------|-----|
| **401 Unauthorized** | Verify the key spelling/case; ensure no trailing spaces. |
| **429 Too Many Requests** | Wait until your quota resets or upgrade plan. |
| **Domain not found** | Double‑check DNS resolution; try `api.victor.io/...` instead of `v3.domains.twitter.com`. |
| **Rate limiting per minute** | Add `--retry-all-errors` flag in cURL or implement exponential backoff in scripts. |

---

That’s all! Run one of those snippets locally, and you should see JSON containing everything VirusTotal has collected about `twitter.com`.
